title: Hang Seng_ Project Manager
description:
Commercial Banking:
- Hang Seng's Commercial Banking (CMB) business provides customized one-stop financial solutions to our corporate customers, from prime small and medium-sized businesses to publicly listed companies.
- For customers conducting business locally or around the world, we offer a comprehensive range of services including corporate lending, trade and receivables finance, structured loan, cash management, investment, treasury services, insurance, project financing, property development financing, property investment loans, working capital financing and e-Banking services. As a reliable financial partner, we attend to the specific business needs of our customers and provide efficient tailor-made banking solutions through our relationship managers and dedicated specialists.
- We are currently seeking high caliber individual to join us as Project Manager.

Principal responsibilities:
- Provide project management and consultancy services on project/ system implementation, process workflow design, and process re-engineering in Commercial Banking
- Actively monitor the project scope and resources to meet the project schedule and budget
- Work closely with various stakeholders including business users, operations, IT, audit, legal and compliance to ensure effective project governance
- Work with various CMB businesses/ functions on project prioritization to optimize resources usage, with the responsibility to oversee the overall budget management, resources allocation and prioritization amongst all projects
- Lead the project team in conducting comprehensive change impact and adoption assessments to ensure post-implementation business readiness
- Proactively manage all the potential risks, issues and dependencies on projects and recommend mitigating measures if required
- Keep abreast on latest technology/ best practices in banking industry and deliver changes to current processes with efficiency and cost improvement
- Foster a high engagement team to deliver good quality outputs which exceed user expectations

Qualifications:
- University graduate in related disciplines or other relevant qualifications
- Minimum 8 years of banking experience, preferably with knowledge of business banking products and bank operations. Knowledge in lending / payments / wealth / digital banking / digital channels / customer lifecycle management will be an advantage
- Previous experience as a project manager in medium-to-large scale projects will be a plus
- Ability to overcome challenges, create innovative solutions and work in an agile environment
- Ability to communicate effectively and create connection with others
- Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Chinese (Cantonese & Mandarin)
- Great sense of ownership and servicing mindset to ensure efficient and effective customer service processes.

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
Designation : Desktop Support Engineer
Location : Hong Kong
Position : Permanent
Budget : As per Market standard
Experience : 4+ Years

Candidates must be based out of Hong Kong to apply for this role.Location: Hong Kong Function: Digital Workplace / Field Services Reporting to: Regional Service Manager (APAC)

Role Purpose

Provide high-quality onsite IT support across corporate offices and retail stores with strong focus on VIP support, retail systems, and end-user experience.

Key Responsibilities

· Provide L1/L2 deskside support for devices, peripherals, and AV systems

· Deliver white-glove VIP/executive support

· Support retail systems including POS, payment devices, scanners

· Manage incidents and service requests via ITSM tools

· Execute IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) activities

· Support asset lifecycle and inventory compliance

· Collaborate with global teams and vendors

Technical Skills

· Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive)

· Active Directory / Azure AD

· Basic networking (LAN/Wi-Fi/VPN)

· Hardware troubleshooting (Dell, Client, Lenovo, Mac)

· AV/VC systems (Teams Rooms, Zoom, Cisco)

Experience

· 4–6+ years deskside/field support experience

· Experience in retail or luxury environments

· Proven VIP/executive support experience

· Exposure to ITIL processes and global enterprise environments

Soft Skills

· Strong communication (English mandatory, Cantonese preferred)

· Customer-focused and professional

· Ability to work under pressure
